_comment: Flux raster logo prompt templates. Edit strings here; variable substitution happens at runtime. Available variables: {brand} (uppercase brand name), {concept} (visual concept element — pre-formatted string with leading space, or empty), {colors} (full color instruction string), {bg} (background instruction string), {shape_block} (shape constraint sentence, or empty string), {no_text} (text constraint — pre-formatted string with leading space).
shape_block: Hard shape constraint: the entire logo is fully enclosed inside a perfect {SHAPE} container. Nothing extends outside the {Shape}.

default_colors.professional: navy blue and gold color palette.

no_text.icon_only: There is absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO typography anywhere in the image. Zero text of any kind. Pure graphic symbol only.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text in the entire image is "{brand}". Do not add any other words, letters, taglines, slogans, or captions anywhere in the image.
